calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for handdii
calls.summary: Cameron Dechene, Product Manager at Handdii, discussed his need for an A/B testing and feature flag platform to enable data-driven decisions without burdening his small engineering team. GrowthBook’s Daniel Wathne (sales) and Logan Bates (solutions engineer) demonstrated the visual editor, experiment setup, and integration with Heap, addressing pain points around low traffic and simple UI changes. Next steps: Cameron will sign up for the free tier to explore the platform, and Daniel will share the call recording and relevant documentation for further evaluation.
